item.title: ‘Winter Wonderland’ show opens Feb. 1
item.description: Fayette, Mo. – The Ashby-Hodge Gallery of American Art, on the campus of Central Methodist University, will host two works by one of the country’s most famous artists as part of its “Winter Wonderland” exhibit, opening February 1. The pair of Andy Warhol portraits, generously loaned by Drs. Beth ’82 and Todd Whitaker, will be on display in the Bingham Gallery.

item.title: Community Garden seeking new care taker
item.description: For many, many years, the Prairie Home Garden Club beautifully cared for the community flower bed, which is located between the bank and the Methodist church hall. In the last few years, Glenda Sells and her small band of merry helpers has kept it looking great. The community is grateful to everyone who has worked in the flower garden over the years. item.title: Farm Service Agency announces updated schedule for county committee elections
item.description: The U.S. Department of Agriculture (USDA) has revised the Farm Service Agency (FSA) county committee voting period, and eligible agricultural producers and private landowners across the country should begin receiving ballots beginning the week of Jan. 5.
